notes: ἐνώπιον takes the whole frame 'in the presence of' including its trailing 'of', headed on 'presence' (rule 71), and the following article keeps a bare 'the' (rule 95).
ὅτι is written out as 'that' here, so it is aligned in the ordinary way; LUK.8.49's recitative ὅτι is left unrepresented, which is rule 43's English-side test and not two analyses.
